title: Two cipher recipes in a Dresden manuscript

steps.what: The facing manuscript alphabet on f. 248v gives the sign values.
Filed the issue evidence and checked the line replay against the submitted transcription and key.

Page review: the page now gives the key with a worked example, the recipes in English and the extent measured on signs (1,463 of 1,470 valued) apart from the word share (305 of 310 sure words in the two recipes). The cipher-reveal passage was given its word divisions.

outcome.method_basis: The facing manuscript alphabet on f. 248v gives the sign values.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Transcription files 249r, 249v and 250r: 1,463 of 1,470 signs carry a value; 7 are unread ('?' x6 and the quantity mark on 249r line 18). Clear numerals are not counted. Word share is separate and counts the two recipes only: 150 of 154 sure words on f. 249r and 155 of 156 on f. 249v (305 of 310, 98%); the f. 250r fragment is outside both counts.

texts.summary: Recipe for a man afflicted with leprosy for a year: a herb bath, swan broth, bloodletting and a distilled water to drink; German, written in the symbol alphabet.

reading_review.by: Codex independent claims review, Piccolomini and Dresden
reading_review.note: The German readings and translations are coherent. The review checked the known alphabet, sign output and the conservative denominators of 154 and 156 words. Image spot checks are recorded in the prior review.

texts.summary: Recipe for writing in the sun with lion's blood and herb leaves, then burning them with rosemary wood in sunshine, with a warning about the smoke; German, written in the symbol alphabet.

reading_review.by: Codex independent claims review, Piccolomini and Dresden
reading_review.note: The German readings and translations are coherent. The review checked the known alphabet, sign output and the conservative denominators of 154 and 156 words. Image spot checks are recorded in the prior review. The contributor follow-up confirmed both words of the phrase in iren, leaving one open word and giving 155/156 (99.4%).

texts.summary: The first four cipher lines of a third text, announcing the characters of the seven planets, Saturn first; a fragment, not part of either recipe.
